readBy: Elections (from the playtest check, PR #7721, which read the town's pages)
note: Towns whose own charter sets a different governing body than their state's default, by county subdivision code (county GEOID plus the subdivision's five-digit code). A town not listed takes its state's reading (township-governing-bodies.json). Rows are added from the town's charter; this file is a known-small start, one row per charter read. CT's 40 largest towns added Nov 8 from town pages, the CT Register and Manual, and search summaries (confidence per row; medium rows are summaries, not the charter text); representative-town-meeting towns, Trumbull, Naugatuck and low-confidence rows are not read yet.

0911044700.name: Manchester town, Connecticut
0911044700.citation: Manchester, Connecticut is council-manager: a Board of Directors of eight directors and a directly elected mayor (two-year terms); the board hires the Town Manager (called the General Manager until the 2022 charter, which also made the mayor directly elected).

0912008070.name: Bridgeport town, Connecticut
0912008070.citation: Bridgeport's council has 20 members, two per district (1967 reorganization: ten districts, each electing a pair); mayor-council form [WebSearch summary of onlyinbridgeport.com / bridgeportct.gov; Wikipedia: "Twenty members of the city council are elected from districts."] (Nov 2025 charter revision approved by voters; whether it changed council size not confirmed (a 20->10 cut was floated). Council term 2y from a ~2004 profile.)

0919073070.name: Stamford town, Connecticut
0919073070.citation: The forty members of the Board of Representatives are elected from twenty districts, with each district electing two representatives every four years, concurrent with the Mayor's term. (Quote text is from Wikipedia Stamford page (Government section); boardofreps.org states same facts. 2023 charter revision that would have shifted appointments failed.)

0917052070.name: New Haven town, Connecticut
0917052070.citation: The city council, called the Board of Alders, consists of thirty members, each elected from single-member districts. ... Beginning in 2027, all mayor and alder terms are four years. (termYears 2 now; 4 from 2027 (2023 charter revision, ctmirror.org/2023/11/13/new-haven-stamford-ct-charter-revisions-passed-failed/).)

0911037070.name: Hartford town, Connecticut
0911037070.citation: The city council, formally known as the "Court of Common Council", has nine members. (Strong-mayor since 2002 charter. 4-year term from Ballotpedia summary; 2022 charter amendment (hartfordct.gov) may have changed composition, unconfirmed.)

0914080070.name: Waterbury town, Connecticut
0914080070.citation: the mayor and the 15 aldermen at large are elected biennially in odd years [WebSearch paraphrase of waterburyct.gov/administration] (Mayor term 2y per same page; a 2014 board vote proposed 4y mayor term, outcome unconfirmed. 2025 charter PDF: https://waterburyct.org/filestorage/103431/106697/106738/2025_Charter.pdf)

0919056060.name: Norwalk town, Connecticut
0919056060.citation: Norwalk's common council consists of fifteen council members, five elected at-large and ten elected by district, two from each district. (Council voted Aug 2025 to keep 15 members; Nov 4 2025 ballot questions incl. 4-year terms (from 2029 mayor, 2031 council) outcome not found.)

0919018500.name: Danbury town, Connecticut
0919018500.citation: The council consists of twenty-one members, two from each district, and seven at large, all of whom shall serve a term of two years. (Wikipedia: "The Mayor is the presiding officer of the City Council". Charter revision proposing 4-year terms from 2027 is on the Nov 2026 ballot (portal.ct.gov Nov 2026 Danbury sample ballot).)

0911050440.name: New Britain town, Connecticut
0911050440.citation: the Common Council is comprised of a total of fifteen members, and the Mayor is considered the chief executive and administrative officer (2022 charter change made it 15 members, three from each of five districts (previously 10 district + 5 at-large).)

0911082590.name: West Hartford town, Connecticut
0911082590.citation: the council elects its own president, who holds the title of mayor ... Town Council members are elected at large for two years [ecode360.com/12119284; Wikipedia] (bodySize 9 not confirmed by a quoted line this pass (mayor is one of the council).)

0917035650.name: Hamden town, Connecticut
0917035650.citation: Hamden is governed by a mayor-council form of government, with a 15-member legislative council. Six councilors are elected at large while the other nine are elected by district. (Mayor term moved to 4 years (2022 charter, from 2025); council kept 2-year terms (New Haven Independent via WebSearch).)

0917046520.name: Meriden town, Connecticut
0917046520.citation: The City Council shall be composed of 12 members ... The mayor ... presides over the council, and does not vote on Council matters except in the case of a tie [WebSearch summary of ecode360.com/13471512, meridenct.gov] (Council appoints City Manager (the CEO); mayor is a separately elected presiding officer, two-year term.)

0914008490.name: Bristol town, Connecticut
0914008490.citation: The City Council is made up of six members, elected every two years from three two member districts. (2022 proposal to expand to nine was rejected by the council. Whether mayor presides unknown.)

0912074190.name: Stratford town, Connecticut
0912074190.citation: The Council shall consist of ten (10) members, (ecode360 hit title for Stratford charter; stratfordct.gov: ten-member council elected by district, two-year terms, mayor since 2005.)

0917047535.name: Milford town, Connecticut
0917047535.citation: The Board of Aldermen consists of 15 members elected in odd-numbered years, three from each of the city's five political districts. (Charter: "The elected officials of the City shall be: Mayor, members of the Board of Aldermen, Town Clerk ... who all shall hold office for a term of two years" (ecode360.com/14500808). March 2026 vote to open charter (4-year mayor) failed 9-5, needed two-thirds.)

0911022630.name: East Hartford town, Connecticut
0911022630.citation: nine members of the Town Council are each elected for terms of two years (Strong mayor; 2022 question on 4-year mayor term outcome unverified.)

0913047360.name: Middletown town, Connecticut
0913047360.citation: The Common Council shall consist of twelve (12) members. (Mayor chairs council meetings but cannot cast tie-breaking vote (2025 participation guide). Council term conflicting (a 2021 CRC doc says 4y) so left null.)

0917078740.name: Wallingford town, Connecticut
0917078740.citation: The Town Council Chairman shall be the Deputy Mayor, and shall exercise the powers, duties and obligations of the Office of Mayor during the temporary absence or temporary disability of the Mayor. (Charter: Mayor + nine Town Council members, not more than six of one party, two-year terms (https://www.wallingfordct.gov/Customer-Content/www/CMS/files/Charter-Wallingford-Final.pdf). Chairman presides.)

0911070550.name: Southington town, Connecticut
0911070550.citation: The Council shall consist of nine (9) members, who shall be (Southington.org: council-manager since 1966, nine-member Town Council at large, two-year terms, council appoints one member as Chairman.)

0911025990.name: Enfield town, Connecticut
0911025990.citation: Enfield runs a council-manager government with 11 partisan members on the Town Council [ICMA job post via WebSearch] (Council selects the mayor (council chairperson). Wikipedia lists district and at-large councilors.)

0918056270.name: Norwich town, Connecticut
0918056270.citation: The City Council consists of six members and one mayor, all elected at large ... mayor is elected at large for a four-year term, is a voting member of the City Council (Wikipedia: Mayor serves max two four-year terms; council members two-year terms. City manager appointed by council. 2001 charter cut council from 11 to 6.)

0918034250.name: Groton town, Connecticut
0918034250.citation: The council consists of nine members elected at large by the citizens of the Town. Council members are elected for two-year terms. (Also has an elected Representative Town Meeting (approves budgets; ~41 seats per 2019 Patch) and town manager. Mayor chosen by the council.)

0916076570.name: Torrington town, Connecticut
0916076570.citation: the Board, consisting of six members and chaired by Mayor Molly Spino, exercises oversight of all City departments and employees (Charter Revision Commission active mid-2026. Council term not confirmed (2 assumed by pattern - treat as unverified).)

0911031240.name: Glastonbury town, Connecticut
0911031240.citation: The Town Council consists of nine (9) members serving two (2) year terms. (Minority party must hold at least three seats; manager appointed by council; chairman selection process unverified.)

0911052140.name: Newington town, Connecticut
0911052140.citation: The Town Council is the legislative body for the Town of Newington, and nine members are elected to serve two year terms. The Mayor, elected separately, is a member and presiding official of the council with the power to vote. (Wikipedia says nine members including the elected mayor; WebSearch (newingtonct.gov) says eight besides the mayor. bodySize 8 = non-mayor seats.)

0911078250.name: Vernon town, Connecticut
0911078250.citation: The Council consists of 12 members elected to two-year terms. [vernon-ct.gov/about via WebSearch] (Mayor is CEO, elected at large for two years; mayor-town council since 1970. Council size from town site; verify charter.)

0911087000.name: Windsor town, Connecticut
0911087000.citation: The legislative function is performed by a bipartisan council of nine members, who are elected biennially for two-year terms. The town council elects a mayor from its membership for the two-year term, and also appoints the town manager. (Same text on windsorct.gov/581 via WebSearch. Not in OLR 2020-R-0332 manager table (omitted there).)

0914014160.name: Cheshire town, Connecticut
0914014160.citation: the nine elected officials are volunteers who serve two-year terms [cheshirect.gov Town Council page via WebSearch] (Chairperson selected by the Council; Town Manager appointed by Council and is CEO (cheshirect.gov/262).)

0919052630.name: New Milford town, Connecticut
0919052630.citation: nine (9) members of the Town Council, each of whom shall be elected for terms of two (2) years ... the Mayor who shall be elected for a term of two (2) years (Also has Town meeting and Board of Finance (Register Manual).)

0918052350.name: New London town, Connecticut
0918052350.citation: The City Council is the City's legislative body, consisting of seven members. Its members are elected at large and serve for two-year terms. (2010 charter replaced city manager with a four-year elected mayor with veto (six of seven votes override); first mayor elected 2011.)

0911084900.name: Wethersfield town, Connecticut
0911084900.citation: mayor and deputy mayor are selected by a majority vote of the nine members at the first meeting following an election (Town website: Council/Manager form; nine members, two-year terms.)
